overview.title: Project Overview
overview.content: Roaya Clinic Management System is a robust web-based solution designed specifically for ophthalmic practices. Built on a solid PHP MVC foundation, it bridges the gap between clinical efficiency and patient care quality. The system offers distinct roles (Admin, Doctor, Secretary) to ensure secure and optimized access to information.

components.visual_acuity_desc: Shows latest visual acuity measurements with trend indicators (improving, worsening, stable)

components.dry_eye_desc: Shows OSDI score and severity with trend analysis from osdi_results table
components.alerts_desc: Automatically generated alerts for critical conditions (IOP above target, visual acuity deterioration, worsening macular thickness, severe dry eye)
components.mini_trends_desc: Quick visual indicators for IOP, Visual Acuity, and Macular Thickness trends
components.summary_desc: Auto-generated text summary of all clinical data with copy-to-clipboard functionality

unified_clinical_dashboard.integration_description: The Unified Clinical Dashboard is automatically integrated into patient profile pages and appointment pages. metrics.doctors: Doctors - Total number of doctor accounts
metrics.secretaries: Secretaries - Total number of secretary accounts

patients.title: Patients Statistics
patients.description: Total patient count in the system with active patient information.

appointments.title: Appointments Statistics
appointments.description: Appointment metrics for the last 30 days including completion and cancellation rates.

metrics.total: Total Appointments - All appointments in the last 30 days

financial.title: Financial Statistics

metrics.transactions: Total Transactions - Number of payment transactions

stats.time_range: Time Range: Last 30 days for appointments and financial data

users_stats.title: Users Statistics Card
users_stats.description: Displays comprehensive user statistics including total users, active users, and breakdown by role (doctors and secretaries).

metrics.total_desc: Count of all registered users in the system

users_stats.query: Query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN role = 'doctor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN role = 'secretary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM users

patients_stats.title: Patients Statistics Card
patients_stats.description: Shows total patient count in the system with active patient information.

metrics.active_desc: Patients with recent appointments or activity

patients_stats.query: Query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_patients FROM patients

appointments_stats.title: Appointments Statistics Card
appointments_stats.description: Displays appointment statistics for the last 30 days including total, completed, and cancelled appointments.

metrics.total_desc: All appointments in the last 30 days

appointments_stats.query: Query: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM appointments WHERE date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
appointments_stats.time_range: Time Range: Last 30 days (CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)

financial_stats.title: Financial Statistics Card
financial_stats.description: Shows financial metrics including total revenue, transaction count, and discounts for the last 30 days.

metrics.revenue_desc: Sum of all payment amounts in the last 30 days
metrics.discounts_desc: Sum of all discount amounts applied

financial_stats.query: Query: SELECT SUM(amount) as total_revenue, SUM(discount_amount) as total_discounts, COUNT(*) as total_payments FROM payments WHERE DATE(created_at) >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
financial_stats.time_range: Time Range: Last 30 days (CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)

recent_activities.title: Recent Activities

hero.title: Settings
hero.subtitle: Configure personal preferences, system settings, visit costs, and manage drugs database updates

overview.title: Overview
overview.content: The Settings page allows doctors to customize their personal preferences, manage system-wide settings, configure visit costs, and update the drugs database. Settings are saved per user and persist across sessions.

personal_preferences.title: Personal Preferences
personal_preferences.content: Personal preferences are user-specific settings that customize the doctor's experience. These settings are stored in the doctor_settings table and apply only to the current user.

alerts.title: Don't Create Alert for Appointments
alerts.desc: When enabled, new appointments will not automatically create alerts. This prevents automatic alert generation when scheduling appointments.

notifications.title: Don't Create Notification for Appointments
notifications.desc: When enabled, appointment actions (create, update, delete) will not automatically create system notifications.

back_to_top.title: Back to Top Display
back_to_top.desc: Show or hide the scroll-to-top button that appears when scrolling down the page. The button allows quick navigation to the top of the page.

dock.title: Quick Access Dock
dock.desc: Show or hide the quick access dock on desktop. The dock provides quick access to frequently used features like Calendar, Patients, and Drugs.

dock_autohide.title: Dock Auto-Hide
dock_autohide.desc: Automatically hide the dock when not in use. The dock will show on hover when hidden, providing a cleaner interface while maintaining quick access.

theme.title: Current Mode (Theme)
theme.desc: Switch between dark and light theme. The theme preference is saved and persists across sessions. Changes apply immediately.

push_notifications.title: Push Notifications
push_notifications.desc: Enable or disable browser push notifications. When enabled, the system will request notification permission and subscribe the current browser to receive push notifications.
push_notifications.note: Requires browser permission. Multiple browsers can be subscribed.

sidebar_items.title: Sidebar Items
sidebar_items.desc: Select which items to display in the sidebar. Some items (Dashboard, Calendar, Patients, About, Logout) are always enabled and cannot be hidden.

general_settings.title: General Settings
general_settings.content: General settings are system-wide configurations that affect all users. These settings control clinic information, branding, and logos used throughout the system.

clinic_info.title: Clinic Information
clinic_info.desc: Configure basic clinic information that appears in reports, invoices, and printed documents.

logos.title: Clinic Logos
logos.desc: Upload and manage clinic logos for different purposes. Logos are used in printed documents, watermarks, and system branding.

fields.main: Main Logo - Used in system interface (disabled in settings, can be updated elsewhere)
fields.print: Print Logo - Used in printed prescriptions and documents
fields.watermark: Watermark Logo - Used as watermark in printed documents

logos.note: Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, SVG. Maximum file size: 5MB. Logos can be uploaded via file input or by providing file path.

visit_costs.title: Visit Costs
visit_costs.content: Configure the costs for different types of visits. These costs are used in financial calculations and can be referenced when creating appointments or processing payments.

new_visit.title: New Visit Cost
new_visit.desc: The cost required for the first visit to a patient. This is the standard consultation fee for new patients.

followup.title: Follow-Up Visit Cost
followup.desc: The cost required for repeated visits to a patient. This is typically lower than the new visit cost.

consultation.title: Consultation/Medical Procedure Cost
consultation.desc: The cost required for consultation or medical procedures. This can be used for specialized consultations or procedures.

drugs_database.title: Drugs Database Update
drugs_database.content: Update the drugs database from the official source. This process downloads the latest drug information and updates your local SQLite database with new and updated drug records.

update_process.title: Update Process
update_process.content: The database update process consists of several steps that are executed sequentially:

steps.download: Downloading - Downloads the latest database file from the official source
steps.extract: Extracting - Extracts data from the source database file
steps.update: Updating - Updates the local database with new and modified records
steps.complete: Completion - Displays statistics (total records, inserted, updated) and reloads the page

statistics.total_desc: Total number of records processed during the update
statistics.inserted_desc: Number of new records added to the database
statistics.updated_desc: Number of existing records that were updated

hero.title: Medical AI Assistant
hero.subtitle: Intelligent AI-powered assistant for patient history analysis, consultation summarization, and clinical decision support

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The Medical AI Assistant is a comprehensive AI-powered tool integrated into patient and appointment pages. It provides intelligent analysis of patient medical history, consultation summarization, and context-aware clinical guidance. The system also includes intelligent autocomplete for consultation fields, common complaints extraction, and prescription suggestions based on diagnosis and complaints.

patient_history.title: Patient History Analysis
patient_history.description: Comprehensive analysis of complete patient medical history including conditions, medications, consultations, lab tests, and glasses prescriptions.

consultation_summary.title: Consultation Summarization
consultation_summary.description: Automatic summarization of consultation data including chief complaint, clinical findings, diagnosis, treatment plan, and follow-up recommendations.

context_aware.title: Context-Aware Responses
context_aware.description: AI responses are based strictly on provided patient data and consultation information, ensuring accuracy and relevance.

chat_widget.title: AI Chat Widget
chat_widget.description: A floating chat widget available on patient and appointment pages that provides quick access to AI-powered analysis and summarization features.
chat_widget.disclaimer: AI Assistant: This tool provides guidance and suggestions only. Always use your clinical judgment and verify all information. AI responses should not replace professional medical decision-making.

patient_history.title: Send Patient History
patient_history.description: Analyzes complete patient medical history and provides comprehensive insights.

items.medical_conditions: Key medical conditions and their progression
items.consultation_notes: Consultation notes and diagnoses over time

consultation_summary.title: Summarize Consultation
consultation_summary.description: Provides a comprehensive summary of the current consultation.

items.history_context: Context from patient's previous medical history

technical.title: Technical Details
technical.api_description: The chat widget communicates with the backend API to send messages and receive AI-generated responses. The backend builds comprehensive context from patient data and consultation records.
technical.context_building: The system automatically builds context from multiple data sources:

context_items.appointments: All appointment records and consultation notes
context_items.lab_tests: Laboratory test results and radiology reports
context_items.chat_history: Previous chat messages for conversation continuity

autocomplete.title: Intelligent Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Smart autocomplete functionality for consultation fields (Chief Complaint, Diagnosis, Plan) that suggests previously used entries based on user input.

debounce.title: Debounced Input
debounce.description: Input is debounced with a 300ms delay to reduce API calls and improve performance.

keyboard_nav.title: Keyboard Navigation
keyboard_nav.description: Full keyboard support with Arrow Up/Down for navigation, Enter to select, and Escape to close suggestions.

fields.title: Supported Fields
fields.description: Autocomplete is available for the following consultation fields:

technical.title: Technical Implementation
technical.implementation: The autocomplete system queries the database for similar entries based on the field type and user input. Suggestions are ranked by usage frequency and relevance.

common_complaints.title: Common Complaints System
common_complaints.description: Automatically extracts and groups common complaints from consultation notes, providing quick access to frequently used complaints and diagnoses.

extraction.title: Automatic Extraction
extraction.description: The system analyzes consultation notes and extracts common complaint-diagnosis-plan combinations, grouping similar entries together.

auto_update.title: Daily Updates
auto_update.description: Common complaints are automatically updated daily via cron job, ensuring the list reflects the most current patterns.

quick_fill.title: Quick Fill
quick_fill.description: Clicking on a common complaint automatically fills the Chief Complaint, Diagnosis, and Plan fields, saving time during consultation entry.

technical.title: Technical Details
technical.storage: Common complaints are stored in a JSON file (app/storage/common_complaints.json) and updated daily via a cron job script.
technical.cron: The cron job runs daily at 10 PM to update the common complaints list:

prescription_suggestions.title: Prescription Suggestions
prescription_suggestions.description: Intelligent prescription suggestions based on diagnosis and complaint, showing medications that have been previously prescribed for similar cases.

based_on.title: Based on Diagnosis & Complaint
based_on.description: Suggestions are generated by matching the current diagnosis and complaint with historical prescription data.

usage_stats.title: Usage Statistics
usage_stats.description: Each suggestion displays how many times it has been used, helping doctors make informed decisions.

bulk_add.title: Bulk Add
bulk_add.description: Multiple prescriptions can be selected and added at once, streamlining the prescription entry process.

technical.title: Technical Details
technical.algorithm: The system queries the database for prescriptions that match the diagnosis and complaint, ranks them by frequency of use, and presents them in a user-friendly modal interface.
